spans.s: लेह m. 1. Licking; (मधुनोलेह ‘a bee.’ Bt.vi.82); 2. tasting; 3. food.
लेहन n. Licking, tasting with the tongue.
लेह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) To be licked, to be eaten by licking, R.v.73.
लेह्य (II) n. 1. Any article of food that is to be eaten by licking; 2. nectar.
लेह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) To be licked, to be eaten by licking, R.v.73.
